description: List the path-scoped rule ignores stored for one website: each is a rule id plus a path glob, and findings of that rule on matching page paths are left out of later audit reports, their score and the issue tracker while the organization has path ignores switched on (`enabled`). Also returns `ignored_issues`, how many tracker issues are held by an ignore (status ignored: reversible, not resolved).
name: list_path_ignores
title: List a website's path ignores
